Russia intensifies attacks on Ukraine's capital and infrastructure

Russia launched a renewed wave of drone and missile attacks targeting Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, and its infrastructure. Attacks on Kyiv occurred for a second consecutive day, with reports of drones hitting railway facilities and igniting fires. Ukrainian officials stated that Russian attacks on food warehouses destroyed 90% of their capacity. The broader conflict is described as becoming more ruthless and destructive without nearing an end, with Ukraine warning of a 'weaponised winter'.
